title: Roundhill Furniture Biony Gray Fabric Dining Chairs with Nailhead Trim, Set of 2

reviews.title: Great buy!
reviews.body: Love these chairs!  Needed to update my dining room and this did the trick. They were easy to put together, comfortable and look great!  I ordered 8 chairs all came in perfect condition and were well packed.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 24 May 2026
reviews.author: Donna

reviews.title: They’re very dare also just right for the grandkids
reviews.body: I like the chairs very much they’re very pretty. I put them together myself, which was just a little bit hard because of course I made years old. But when I got the first one up, I noticed they were too short. They didn’t set up tall enough, which was my fault. I kept them anyway.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 7 June 2026
reviews.author: ladybug

reviews.title: One of the best dining chair
reviews.body: I love the elegant design of these chairs including their packaging and prompt delivery. The chair looks very rich. Thank you.
reviews.author: blandina

features: Set of 2 enticing nailhead trim dining chair, soft fabric upholstery on the seat and chair back.

Some assembly required, all parts and instructions included
